A patient presents with chronic, progressive pain in the left first metatarsophalangeal (MTP) joint, hips, and knees. The patient presents with chronic, progressive pain in multiple weight-bearing joints — first MTP (hallux rigidus), hips, and knees — with imaging-confirmed structural changes (joint space narrowing, osteophytes) characteristic of osteoarthritis. Primary generalized osteoarthritis
